```{=html}
<style>
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   PROTOTYPE ONLY. Everything here is scoped to .lp-* classes and lives in
   this page so it cannot affect the rest of the site. If we keep this
   direction, these rules move into style/sta199.scss and the hardcoded
   hexes become brand variables.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;600;700;800&display=swap');

.lp-hero,
.lp-cards,
.lp-week { --lp-poseidon: #133955;
           --lp-aboard:   #5C97CB;
           --lp-egret:    #F3ECE0;
           --lp-green:    #7FBB9E;
           --lp-clay:     #D29380;
           --lp-under:    #83807B; }

/* ---------- Pandoc/Quarto artifact cleanup ----------
   Pandoc wraps each heading in a <section> and each inline block in <p>, and
   Quarto's anchorJS adds hover anchor links to every heading. None of that is
   wanted inside the hero or the cards, so neutralize it locally. */

.lp-hero section,
.lp-cards section,
.lp-week section { margin: 0; }

.lp-eyebrow p,
.lp-card-icon p,
.lp-btns p,
.lp-hero-logo p { margin: 0; }

.lp-hero .anchorjs-link,
.lp-cards .anchorjs-link,
.lp-week .anchorjs-link { display: none !important; }

.lp-card-body p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */

.lp-hero {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 120% at 85% -10%, #1d5480 0%, transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, #133955 0%, #0d2739 100%);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 4.5rem 2rem 4rem;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.lp-hero-inner {
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.lp-hero-logo img {
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45));
}

.lp-hero-text { flex: 1 1 380px; }

.lp-eyebrow {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: .78rem;
  letter-spacing: .22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--lp-green);
  margin-bottom: .9rem;
}

.lp-hero h1 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.2rem);
  line-height: .98;
  letter-spacing: -.03em;
  margin: 0 0 .6rem;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
}

.lp-hero h2 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 300;
  font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 2.4vw, 1.6rem);
  line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
  margin: 0 0 1.9rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .82);
  border: none;
  max-width: 30ch;
}

.lp-btns { display: flex; gap: .85rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.lp-btn {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: .98rem;
  padding: .7rem 1.6rem;
  border-radius: 100px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, background .15s ease;
  display: inline-block;
}

.lp-btn-primary {
  background: var(--lp-green);
  color: #0d2739 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(127, 187, 158, .3);
}

.lp-btn-primary:hover {
  background: #93cbaf;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(127, 187, 158, .4);
}

.lp-btn-ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: #fff !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .35);
}

.lp-btn-ghost:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .6);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* ---------- Info cards ---------- */

.lp-cards {
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: -2.5rem auto 3.5rem;
  padding: 0 2rem;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.lp-card {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e6e9ec;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.35rem;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(19, 57, 85, .09);
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
}

.lp-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(19, 57, 85, .15);
}

.lp-card-icon {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  color: var(--lp-aboard);
  margin-bottom: .7rem;
}

.lp-card h3 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: .8rem;
  letter-spacing: .13em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--lp-under);
  margin: 0 0 .6rem;
  border: none;
}

.lp-card-body { font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.lp-card-body strong { color: var(--lp-poseidon); font-weight: 700; }
.lp-card-body .lp-muted { color: var(--lp-under); font-size: .87rem; }
.lp-card-body a { text-decoration: none; }
.lp-card-body a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* ---------- This week ---------- */

.lp-week {
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto 4rem;
  padding: 0 2rem;
}

.lp-week-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e6e9ec;
  padding-bottom: .7rem;
  margin-bottom: .35rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.lp-week-head h2 {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
  color: var(--lp-poseidon);
  margin: 0;
  border: none;
}

.lp-week-head a {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: .92rem;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.lp-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 4.5rem 1fr auto;
  gap: 1.1rem;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1rem .35rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eef1f3;
}

.lp-row:hover { background: #fafbfc; }

.lp-date {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: .88rem;
  color: var(--lp-under);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.lp-badge {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: .68rem;
  letter-spacing: .09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: .3rem .6rem;
  border-radius: 5px;
  text-align: center;
}

.lp-badge-lec    { background: #13395518; color: #133955; }
.lp-badge-lab    { background: #7FBB9E30; color: #3d6b55; }
.lp-badge-exam   { background: #B9839140; color: #7a4a58; }
.lp-badge-other  { background: #83807B20; color: #5a5854; }

.lp-topic {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 1.03rem;
  color: var(--lp-poseidon);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.lp-due {
  font-size: .85rem;
  color: var(--lp-clay);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: right;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.lp-empty {
  padding: 1.6rem .35rem;
  color: var(--lp-under);
  font-style: italic;
}

@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .lp-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .4rem; }
  .lp-badge { justify-self: start; }
  .lp-due { text-align: left; }
  .lp-hero { padding: 3rem 1.5rem 3.5rem; }
  .lp-hero-inner { gap: 2rem; }
}

/* ---------- Dark mode ---------- */

body.quarto-dark .lp-card {
  background: #242424;
  border-color: #3a3a3a;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
}
body.quarto-dark .lp-card-body strong,
body.quarto-dark .lp-topic,
body.quarto-dark .lp-week-head h2 { color: #e8eef3; }
body.quarto-dark .lp-week-head { border-bottom-color: #3a3a3a; }
body.quarto-dark .lp-row { border-bottom-color: #2e2e2e; }
body.quarto-dark .lp-row:hover { background: #1f1f1f; }
/* The site-wide `linkcolor: "#133955"` is a dark navy that all but vanishes
   on a dark card, so lift links to a legible tint of all-aboard. */
body.quarto-dark .lp-card-body a,
body.quarto-dark .lp-week-head a { color: #8fc0e8; }

body.quarto-dark .lp-badge-lec  { background: #5C97CB30; color: #a8c9e6; }
body.quarto-dark .lp-badge-lab  { background: #7FBB9E30; color: #a5d4bd; }
body.quarto-dark .lp-badge-exam { background: #B9839140; color: #d9b3bd; }
</style>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(googlesheets4)
library(tidyverse)
gs4_deauth()

d <- read_sheet(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mMJwre7sE2RGyorwwn87cyBv6RY1woeV3pKeS_MoQz8/edit?gid=675503730#gid=675503730",
  sheet = "Schedule"
)

today <- Sys.Date()

sched <- d |>
  filter(session != "None") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(map_chr(date, as.character))) |>
  filter(!is.na(date))

# Current Monday-Sunday window; if the semester hasn't started (or the week is
# empty), fall back to the next few sessions so the block is never blank.
monday <- today - (as.integer(format(today, "%u")) - 1)
this_week <- sched |> filter(date >= monday, date <= monday + 6)
heading <- "This week"

if (nrow(this_week) == 0) {
  this_week <- sched |> filter(date >= today) |> slice_head(n = 4)
  heading <- "Coming up"
}

# Strip markdown/HTML links down to their label text for the compact view.
plain <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_replace_all("<br\\s*/?>", " · ") |>
    str_replace_all("<[^>]*>", "") |>
    str_replace_all("\\[([^]]*)\\]\\([^)]*\\)", "\\1") |>
    str_replace_all("[*_]", "") |>
    str_squish()
}

badge_class <- function(s) {
  case_when(
    s == "Lec" ~ "lp-badge-lec",
    s == "Lab" ~ "lp-badge-lab",
    str_detect(coalesce(s, ""), regex("exam", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "lp-badge-exam",
    TRUE ~ "lp-badge-other"
  )
}

cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="lp-week-head"><h2>%s</h2><a href="index.html">Full schedule &rarr;</a></div>\n',
  heading
))

if (nrow(this_week) == 0) {
  cat('<div class="lp-empty">Schedule coming soon.</div>\n')
} else {
  this_week |>
    mutate(
      html = sprintf(
        paste0(
          '<div class="lp-row">',
          '<div class="lp-date">%s</div>',
          '<div class="lp-badge %s">%s</div>',
          '<div class="lp-topic">%s</div>',
          '<div class="lp-due">%s</div>',
          '</div>'
        ),
        format(date, "%a %b %e") |> str_squish(),
        badge_class(session),
        coalesce(session, "—"),
        plain(coalesce(topic, "")),
        plain(coalesce(due, ""))
      )
    ) |>
    pull(html) |>
    walk(~ cat(.x, "\n"))
}
```
